# update-qm

Update a private qm fork by merging upstream qm into it and opening a sync PR. Use when asked to "update qm", "sync from upstream", "pull in the latest qm".

## Use

Ask your agent to use `$update-qm`, or have it read [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) before starting the task.
